shared_resource_envelope.candidate_visible_raw_information: exact frozen restricted/resolving source bytes plus the same public source/version/rights/lineage metadata admitted by the natural-pair packet; no protected gold, adjudicator notes, expected terminal or pair-selection hint
shared_resource_envelope.model_comparators: one frozen NLI inference per state, tokenizer max_length=512, truncation=true, no retrieval and no additional model/tool calls; C2/C3 use exactly the same two state calls and differ only by prospectively frozen escalation/provenance logic
shared_resource_envelope.typed_donor: no learned model call; only the exact candidate-visible typed coordinates; no protected gold or hidden field

backbone.runtime_precondition: model.config label names must expose exactly the three frozen semantic names; numeric label ids are not hard-coded and a mismatch is CANNOT_CHECK_MODEL_BINDING

comparators.identity: original immutable NLI model plus frozen named-label adapter
comparators.prompt_or_input_contract: premise=state text; hypothesis=exact unchanged target claim; encode as native sequence pair; no generation prompt
comparators.entrypoint: transformers AutoTokenizer + AutoModelForSequenceClassification at the exact backbone revision; argmax native named label per state

comparators.identity: declared reimplementation v1 over the immutable NLI backbone
comparators.prompt_or_input_contract: same exact target claim is paired separately with restricted and resolving state text
comparators.rule: restricted must be native neutral to license escalation; otherwise abstain CannotCheck. If neutral, resolving entailment/contradiction/neutral maps to ResolvedTrue/ResolvedFalse/CannotCheck.
forbidden: binary forcing when resolving state is neutral

comparators.identity: declared reimplementation v1 over the immutable NLI backbone plus exact packet-integrity coordinates
comparators.prompt_or_input_contract: same two NLI state calls as C2 plus source identity, content integrity, lineage, rights, state-order and one-coordinate-change booleans from the frozen packet
comparators.entrypoint: c3_provenance_verifier_terminal(...) in the bound adapter source
comparators.rule: any failed/absent provenance coordinate => CannotCheck; provenance cannot manufacture a truth label; all gates passing delegates only to the frozen C2 semantic relation

comparators.identity: separate deterministic implementation in the bound adapter source
comparators.prompt_or_input_contract: none; exact candidate-visible typed coordinates only
comparators.information_parity: exact same ordered field set as candidate; extra or missing field is rejected
comparators.expected_relation: exact equality with candidate on all 3^2 * 2^6 typed states

freeze_rule: Any model revision, adapter source, input contract, native-output map, runtime version, resource envelope or C4 typed coordinate change after adjudication outcomes are consumed creates a new successor identity and cannot replace this comparator family.
